parameters.description: Only return action items created at or after this date. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO datetime, and is inclusive. A value without a time means midnight UTC, so an end bound of 2024-01-05 excludes everything later that day.
parameters.name: created_at_start

parameters.description: Only return action items created at or before this date. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO datetime, and is inclusive. A value without a time means midnight UTC, so an end bound of 2024-01-05 excludes everything later that day.
parameters.name: created_at_end

parameters.description: Only return action items updated at or after this date. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO datetime, and is inclusive. A value without a time means midnight UTC, so an end bound of 2024-01-05 excludes everything later that day. Whether updated_at moves depends on where the change was made. Edits in the note itself, including its text, completion, assignees and due date, all bump updated_at. An assignee or due date changed outside the note, such as from the action items list, is written to a separate record and leaves updated_at unchanged, so this filter does not pick that item up.
parameters.name: updated_at_start

parameters.description: Only return action items updated at or before this date. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO datetime, and is inclusive. A value without a time means midnight UTC, so an end bound of 2024-01-05 excludes everything later that day. Whether updated_at moves depends on where the change was made. Edits in the note itself, including its text, completion, assignees and due date, all bump updated_at. An assignee or due date changed outside the note, such as from the action items list, is written to a separate record and leaves updated_at unchanged, so this filter does not pick that item up.
parameters.name: updated_at_end

fellow_action_item_added_trigger.description: Runs each time an action item is added in Fellow. Ones added before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, text, status, created_at, updated_at, due_date, note_id, assignees, completion_type, ai_detected, recording_offset, ai_suggestion_accepted_by_user
